corrected_fields.summary: The 10-Year Treasury Yield closed at 4.35% on 2026-04-27, up 4 basis points from 4.31% on 2026-04-24. The yield has ranged between 4.30% and 4.35% over the past week, showing modest upward movement.

At 4.35%, it reflects current market pricing of the risk-free rate and expectations for the path of monetary policy. Rising yields generally pressure risk assets and increase financing costs across the economy. [Note: Context added from general macro knowledge, not from source.]
